usedFor: Advogalia holds clients and cases, and Documint receives them when “New Client” runs “Add Content To Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Advogalia, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: A new client's details go into a Documint template, so the document starts from the CRM record.

watchOut: “New Client” in Advogalia is polling, so “Add Content To Template” runs after a scheduled check.
